description: This PHP script manages the setup and dependencies of picklist fields within the vtiger CRM system, including permission checks, AJAX handlers for fetching and saving dependencies, and rendering appropriate templates.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering HTML templates.

methods.name: getDependentPickListModules
methods.description: Retrieves list of modules with dependent picklists.

methods.name: checkCyclicDependency
methods.description: Checks for cyclic dependencies between picklist fields.

methods.name: getAvailablePicklists
methods.description: Gets available picklist options for a module.

methods.name: getDependentPicklistFields
methods.description: Fetches dependent picklist fields for a module.

methods.name: getPickListDependency
methods.description: Retrieves dependency mappings between picklist fields.

methods.name: savePickListDependencies
methods.description: Saves dependency configurations for picklist fields.
